turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Watch me first.
She eats ___ apple. I check the first sound of "apple": "a". It is a vowel sound, so I write "an". She eats an apple.
This is the rule: "an" before a vowel sound, "a" before other sounds.
This is right: I have a pen. This is wrong: I have an pen.
Now it is your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
